sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflow_price_entries pe SET pe.isActive=0,pe.modifiedByUserId=:userId,pe.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pe.id=:id AND pe.workflowId=:workflowId AND pe.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='COMMERCIAL_DETAILS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=pe.tenantId AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='commercial.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:permissionUser AND utr.tenantId=pe.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
